text:
sophia: FYI customer (jordan-customer) reporting sudden p95/p99 jump on /v1/generate, started ~10:10 UTC, some 503s and long tails. full report: TLDR — queueing backlog on inference workers, admission trending to max.
sophia: sample from customer: 503s ~2% of calls, p95 ~1.2s -> 3.8s, p99 ~2.8s -> 9.6s. they sent repro script.
sophia: repro curl they ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"open-xyz","prompt":"hello"}'
```
sophia: attaching our logs (trimmed) — request queue depth climbed rapidly, worker queue wait time spiking:
```
[10:09:58] ingress: enqueue request req=abc123 tenant=acme wait_ms=2
[10:10:02] ingress: dequeue request req=abc124 tenant=acme wait_ms=120
[10:10:05] worker: start req=abc124 shard=gpu-7
[10:10:07] ingress: enqueue request req=abc125 tenant=acme wait_ms=800
[10:10:10] admission: deny req=abc126 reason=concurrency_limit
[10:10:14] worker: finish req=abc120 duration_ms=4800
[10:10:14] ingress: dequeue request req=abc125 tenant=acme wait_ms=4200
```
sophia: customers are seeing retried client-side calls which amplify the pileup. they say it started after a config push earlier today. cc @may a for platform-side change?
liam: digging in runtime metrics now. seeing a 3x increase in avg execution time for open-xyz on nodepool A vs baseline. KV cache hit rate for that model dropped from 82% -> 36%. possible cache invalidation?
liam: also admission controller logs show "slot shortage" spikes and a couple of nodes reporting OOM-throttles around 10:05.
alex: oncall: I see a deploy-bot entry at 10:03 that rolled model runtime image to v2.6.1 across nodepool A (rolling 1/3). deploy-bot: (deployment) runtime:v2.6.1 rolled to nodepool-a-03
maya: I rolled a small config tweak to admission window earlier today to reduce burst capacity (intentional to tighten costs). maybe combined with slower exec we hit the tighter window. reverting could help short-term.
sophia: customer wants ETA and mitigation. proposing immediate mitigations: (1) temporarily expand admission window for nodepool A; (2) enable fallback to smaller model variant for this tenant; (3) advise customer to disable aggressive client retries. any objections?
liam: agree with (1) + (2) for fast relief. fallback route needs a safe contract — can flip routing override for tenant acme to open-xyz-small. I can patch routing in 5-10m.
maya: I can revert the admission window change (was commit 9f3b) — reverting now will allow more in-flight and should reduce wait_ms. rolling revert in progress.
alex: I'll keep an eye on OOM signals, and if nodes still OOM we'll scale up nodepool A by +2 GPUs as emergency. prepping autoscaler override now.
sophia: Jordan-customer, we recommend: 1) hold retries for 2m backoff 2) switch to open-xyz-small for non-critical traffic 3) we will apply platform fixes now. sorry for the disruption. :pray:
jordan-customer: thanks, we can hold retries and will try small model if you flip it. any expected downtime for the revert?
maya: revert is non-disruptive, it's a config change to admission controller, should take effect within 30s.
liam: routing override ready, deploying canary for tenant acme -> open-xyz-small (5% of traffic) now.
liam: canary logs look good, p95 for canary requests ~1.1s. promoting to 100% in 2m if stable.
liam: KV cache warmup for open-xyz-small is favorable, cache hit goes up quickly.
maya: revert complete. admission window back to previous size. seeing immediate drop in deny counts.
alex: autoscaler override applied; +2 GPUs coming up but warmup ~3m.
sophia: we should also patch runtime v2.6.1 config — something in that release changed cache eviction policy. filing issue to eng-runtime. liam, can you capture exact metric deltas for the ticket?
liam: filing ticket ENG-RUNTIME-2189 with metric diffs and cache calltraces.
sophia: action items:
- maya: revert (done)
- liam: routing fallback -> open-xyz-small (canary -> full) (in progress)
- alex: monitor OOM + scale (in progress)
- liam: create ENG-RUNTIME-2189 (done)
- sophia: update customer and close loop once stable
sophia: current status: canary promoted to 100%, p95 back to ~1.2s, p99 trending down to ~2.6s, 503s dropped to 0.1%. queue depth normalizing.
sophia: Jordan, please verify on your side and let us know if you still see spikes. we'll keep this thread pinned for 2h. :thumbsup:
jordan-customer: Verified, p99 back to normal on our tests. thanks team!
sophia: marking as monitoring; will update if anything else. closing notes: root cause likely config tightening + runtime v2.6.1 cache policy change + retry amplification. follow-up: runtime team to revert or fix cache eviction in next patch and add a canary metric for cache hit rate.
